verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a developer platform that ships SDKs and APIs, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, usage tracking, analytics collection or any opt-out control for Crossmint's APIs, SDKs or dashboard. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
